inputs: Per-model optimized routes selected on main development only
standardization: Each task/model uses mean and population standard deviation of its main development margins. A zero standard deviation becomes 1. All five models receive equal weight; no fitted ensemble weights.
selection: Report both ensemble candidates. Best-model routing uses mean source AP on complete primary development; catalog order breaks ties. No test selection.
calibration: Recompute raw, main development maximum-F1 and pooled/every-source 5% FPR thresholds before evaluating cached heldout margins. XRF development calibrates only secondary source metrics.
qualifications: Same retrospective cohorts and weak/provisional labels; no independent evidence from combining model predictions.
